articles.title: Understanding SQL Joins
articles.description: Explore how SQL joins work, how to retrieve related data from multiple tables, and the differences between INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL OUTER JOIN.

articles.title: SQL Command Categories Explained
articles.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to SQL command categories: DDL, DML, DQL, DCL, and TCL, with examples explaining the purpose of each category.

articles.title: Database Indexing: Understanding How Indexes Work
articles.description: Explore database indexes, how they improve query performance, and the trade-offs involved. Learn about B-Tree-based and Hash indexes and when each can be useful.
